title: DRDO DRDL Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for 165 Paid Internship Posts
description: Defence Research and Development Laboratory (DRDL) has published the latest job notification for the recruitment of 165 Paid Internship Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in Any Degree, post-graduation, B.E/ B.Tech, M.E/ M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering can use this chance and apply for the DRDO DRDL Notification 2026 .
